changelog:
Initial release: a local 3D word cloud visualizer for text data.

- Converts conversation history or other text files to a 3D globe word cloud.
- Supports JSON (deep parsing), Markdown, and TXT files with UTF-8-sig encoding.
- Automatically performs Chinese word segmentation, stopword filtering, and word frequency analysis (shows top 30 words).
- Interactive 3D Earth visualization with starfield background; supports rotation, zoom, pan, and export as image.
- Runs fully in-browser, no server or API required; preserves data privacy.
summary: 3D 词云可视化工具 - 将对话历史或其他文本数据自动转换为炫酷的 3D 地球词云，支持多格式文件导入（JSON/MD/TXT），自动中文分词和词频统计，生成 TOP30 高频词的 3D 可视化效果
